label: Hotel Locks History
purpose: Counts of hotel 'locks': hotel options that failed for a customer in the booking flow because the supplier returned no results, a changed price or an error. Used to watch supplier reliability and lost conversions.
grain: One lock event (a failed availability / price recheck or booking attempt of a hotel option from a supplier for a customer).
use_for: number of hotel locks by day, week, month or hour
locks by supplier, hotel, city or country
locks by lock reason (no results, price change, error) and booking-flow step
locks by customer, market, account manager, integrator or channel
not_for: supplier API connection locks (Supplier Lock API Hotel)
how often prices changed overall (KPI Change Price)
bookings or sales (Sales Per Owned Hotels, Bookings)

coverage.note: Data starts mid-October 2025 (the calendar shows empty years back to 2021); the current month is partial. Volumes grew strongly during 2026, so compare periods with care.

dates.label: Lock date
dates.meaning: Day the lock event happened (the cube's only date).

measures.name: [Locks Number]
measures.label: Hotel locks
measures.definition: Number of hotel lock events: a hotel option failed for a customer in the booking flow (cancellation-policy check or booking step) because the supplier returned no results, a changed price or an error.
measures.notes: 'price-change locks' and 'no-results locks' use the named filters of the same name. Not the same as supplier API connection locks (Supplier Lock API Hotel).

breakdowns.label: Lock reason
breakdowns.meaning: Why the hotel option was locked.

breakdowns.label: Booking-flow step
breakdowns.meaning: Step where the lock happened: cancellation-policy check (almost all) or reservation / booking.

breakdowns.label: Channel
breakdowns.meaning: Channel of the request: Xml (API), Web (B2B) or B2C.

breakdowns.label: Supplier
breakdowns.meaning: Supplier connection whose hotel option was locked.

breakdowns.label: Supplier code
breakdowns.meaning: Short code of the supplier connection.

breakdowns.label: Customer
breakdowns.meaning: Client agency whose request was locked.

breakdowns.label: Market
sample_values: GCC - Except UAE and Local Residence

breakdowns.label: Account manager
breakdowns.meaning: Account manager responsible for the customer.

breakdowns.label: Integrator
breakdowns.meaning: Technology integrator the customer connects through.

breakdowns.label: Hour of day
breakdowns.meaning: Hour of day (00-23) of the lock.

breakdowns.label: Quarter
breakdowns.meaning: Quarter of the lock, e.g. Quarter 3, 2026.

breakdowns.label: Month
breakdowns.meaning: Month of the lock, e.g. July 2026.

breakdowns.label: Weekday
breakdowns.meaning: Day of week of the lock.

named_filters.name: no-results locks
named_filters.meaning: Locks because the supplier returned no availability.

named_filters.name: price-change locks
named_filters.meaning: Locks because the supplier's price changed.

named_filters.name: error locks
named_filters.meaning: Locks because of a supplier error.

named_filters.name: booking step
named_filters.meaning: Locks at the reservation / booking step.

named_filters.name: xml channel
named_filters.meaning: Requests through the XML / API channel.

named_filters.name: web channel
named_filters.meaning: Requests through the B2B web channel.

rules: [Locks Number] is the only measure; 'price-change locks', 'no-results locks' and 'error locks' are named filters on 'Lock Types'[Lock Type].
There is no data before 2025-10: say so instead of answering zero for earlier periods.
Always put a breakdown's needs_columns next to it; the Year column needs none.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

review.question: Does a plain 'locks' mean hotel option locks in the booking flow (this cube) or supplier API connection locks (Supplier Lock API Hotel)?
options: Supplier Lock API Hotel lock count
review.proposed: History Hotel Locks [Locks Number]; 'supplier locks' / 'api locks' go to Supplier Lock API Hotel
review.why: Hotel locks are the business-facing event (about 1 million since 2025-10) that account and supplier managers follow; connection locks are a technical safeguard.
